usedFor: Shopify holds your orders, and Notify sends a templated alert through your Notify account when “Send Notification” follows “Order Paid”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Send Notification” in Notify
bestTemplate.why: A paid order sends a templated notification through your Notify account to the recipients you pick.

watchOut: “Send Notification” can go over several channels, so confirm the recipients and channel before turning it on.
